title: Quick Thai Pomelo and Tomato Som Tam
description: Rich, pillowy, comforting Thai dish featuring diced tomatoes and pomelo, served in a clay tajine vessel.

ingredients.name: Thai chilies, seeded and finely chopped

instructions: In a large clay tajine, combine diced tomatoes, chopped cilantro, and Thai chilies.
Add fermented fish sauce (if using) and lime juice, and mix until the chilies are well coated.
Add diced pomelo and mix gently.
Add sugar and mix until well combined.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve immediately, garnished with Thai basil leaves and accompanied by sticky rice or ssam wraps.
For a spicy kick, add more Thai chilies or use hot sauce to taste.
For a tangier flavor, add more lime juice or use vinegar to taste.
For a creamier texture, add a dollop of coconut cream or yogurt to taste.

axes.descriptor: Quick Thai Pomelo and Tomato Som Tam
